sessions.title: A Highly
sessions.description_vi: Sử dụng 'highly' với các từ chỉ xác suất và các từ tích cực, ngoại trừ 'recommended'.
sessions.value:
# Intensifying adverbs

In English there are lots of other ways of saying very or very much. For example, we can use words such as highly, utterly, bitterly, deeply. These alternatives collocate strongly with specific words, and other combinations often sound unnatural.

## A Highly

| collocations | comments |
| --- | --- |
| (un)likely unusual successful competitive profitable effective controversial recommended | **Highly** is used with some probability words (likely, unusual). With the exception of **highly controversial** it usually combines with very positive words. **Extremely** can also be used with all the opposite adjectives except **recommended**. |

It is **highly unlikely** that I’ll finish my work on time.
Julia’s **highly unusual** behaviour began to worry her parents.

sessions.title: B Absolutely, utterly
sessions.description_vi: Sử dụng 'absolutely' và 'utterly' với các tính từ có nghĩa cực đoan, không dùng 'very'.
sessions.value:
## B Absolutely, utterly

| collocations | comments |
| --- | --- |
| ridiculous stupid impossible wrong alone appalled convinced devastated miserable | **Absolutely** and (slightly more formal) **utterly** combine with adjectives with very extreme meanings where we can’t use **very**. For example, we say **absolutely/utterly exhausted**, not **very exhausted**, whereas we say **very tired**, but not **absolutely** or **utterly tired**. Often, but not always, these words have negative connotations. |

It was an **absolutely stupid** comment to make.
The whole area was **utterly devastated** after the earthquake.

sessions.title: C Bitterly, deeply, ridiculously, strongly
sessions.description_vi: Các trạng từ 'bitterly', 'deeply', 'ridiculously', 'strongly' đi kèm với các từ cụ thể và mang sắc thái nghĩa riêng.
sessions.value:
## C Bitterly, deeply, ridiculously, strongly

| word | collocations | comments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| bitterly | disappointing/disappointed resent criticise regret complain cry weep | carries a feeling of deep sadness; used slightly more in writing than in conversation |
| deeply | ashamed concerned shocked committed moved affected hurt (of feelings) regret care religious unhappy | collocates mainly with words associated with feelings; used slightly more in writing than in conversation |
| ridiculously | cheap expensive easy low high long short small large early | suggests something extreme, which seems unbelievable or unreasonable |
| strongly | oppose influence believe deny recommend support condemn suggest feel argue object | collocates with verbs, particularly verbs that relate to having an opinion |

I was **bitterly disappointed** when I failed the exam.
Professor McDellvit was always **deeply committed** to her students.
The restaurant was **ridiculously expensive**. I don’t think we’ll go there again.
I would **strongly recommend** that you learn a foreign language.

image.value: A graph showing a sharp upward trend, symbolizing 'highly successful' or 'highly effective'.

senses.definition_vi: Ở mức độ rất cao; rất.
examples: It is **highly unlikely** that I’ll finish my work on time.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng với các tính từ hoặc trạng từ mang nghĩa tích cực hoặc chỉ xác suất. Ít dùng với các tính từ có nghĩa tiêu cực, ngoại trừ 'highly controversial'.

use_prompts.question: Is it hard to get a job at a top company in your country?
Which teaching methods work best for learning languages?
Which businesses make the most money in your country?

dictation.text: It is highly unlikely that it will rain today.

paraphrase.source: The new method was very successful.
paraphrase.model: The new method was highly successful.

paraphrase.source: Getting into that university is extremely difficult because so many students apply.
paraphrase.model: Getting into that university is highly competitive.

image.value: A person shrugging with a question mark above their head, indicating uncertainty or low probability.

senses.definition_vi: Không có khả năng xảy ra; khó có thể.
examples: It is highly **unlikely** that I’ll finish my work on time.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Khi đi với 'highly', nó nhấn mạnh mức độ không có khả năng xảy ra.

use_prompts.question: Do you think climate change can be stopped completely?
Will robots replace teachers in the near future?
Will people ever work only three days a week?

paraphrase.model: It is highly unlikely that I will finish my work on time.

paraphrase.source: Scientists say there is almost no chance that the virus will return.
paraphrase.model: Scientists say it is highly unlikely that the virus will return.

image.value: A single brightly colored object in a group of monochrome objects, representing 'unusual'.

senses.definition_vi: Khác thường, không phổ biến, không bình thường.
examples: Julia’s **highly unusual** behaviour began to worry her parents.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Khi đi với 'highly', nó nhấn mạnh mức độ khác thường.

image.value: A trophy or a medal, symbolizing success.
